info.title: Real-Time Team Project Management Platform with Predictive Insights
info.summary: FYP SRS v3.0 — design-ready API baseline
info.description:
REST API for the Real-Time Team Project Management Platform. Implements authentication, RBAC, team/project/task management, Kanban workflow, dependencies, collaboration, notifications, attachments, analytics, append-only audit trail, and rule-based PIRAE risk insights.

**Auth:** Access JWT (15 min) + Redis refresh session + JTI blacklist. Logout accepts a `refreshToken` body so an expired access token does not block refresh revocation (Errata E-007 / G-20).

**Status enums:** task = [TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE]; priority = [LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL]; global role = [Administrator, Project Manager, Team Member, Viewer]; team role = [Admin-Assigned, Member]; project role = [Manager, Contributor, Viewer].

**Rate limit:** 100 requests / 15 min / authenticated user.

**PIRAE:** Advisory only — never autonomously mutates project state.

423.description: Account locked (5 failed attempts / 15 min — NFR-SEC-06)

post.summary: Exchange refresh token for a new access token
Logout: blacklist access JTI + revoke refresh session
post.description: Per AC-AUTH-11 and Errata E-007 / G-20: accepts the `refreshToken` in the body so that logout succeeds even when the access token has expired. If a valid access token is also presented, its JTI is additionally blacklisted.

200.description: Session revoked (refresh token removed from Redis; access JTI blacklisted if present)

patch.description: Updates the current user's full name and/or configured capacity. Email change is out of scope for MVP.

patch.summary: Change own password (revokes all refresh sessions)

post.description: Requires an authenticated user with `global_role = Administrator` (FR-AUTH-09). Public self-registration is out of scope.

get.summary: Get user by ID (admin only, or self)

patch.summary: Change user global role (admin only, FR-AUTH-09)
Update team metadata (Admin + PM — FR-AUTH-12, Errata E-005)

post.summary: Add team member (Admin + PM — FR-TEAM-02/03, CA-05)

post.description: Defaults when omitted: status = TODO, priority = MEDIUM, estimatedEffort = 0.

patch.summary: Change task status — Kanban transition (FR-KAN-02, FR-TASK-15)
patch.description: Validates dependency completion before allowing DONE (FR-TASK-15). Triggers real-time `task.status_changed` and PIRAE re-evaluation. Rejected transitions must not leave the client showing an unaccepted state.

409.description: Blocked: open dependencies prevent transition to DONE (FR-TASK-15)

get.summary: List attachments linked to a task (G-11)

post.summary: Add comment with optional mentions (FR-COMM-01, FR-COMM-02)

patch.summary: Edit own comment within 15 minutes (FR-COMM-03, BR-COL-02)

403.description: Not author OR 15-minute edit window expired

get.summary: List attachments linked to a comment (G-11)
Unread notification count for current user (G-10)

post.summary: Upload attachment linked to task XOR comment (FR-ATT-01..05, AC-DATA-07)
post.description: Exactly one of `taskId` or `commentId` must be provided (XOR). Max 10 MB. Allowed MIME: PDF, PNG, JPEG, DOCX, XLSX, TXT (magic-byte validated). No attachment-specific Socket.IO event — invalidate/refetch on success.

415.description: Unsupported MIME type or failed magic-byte check

get.summary: Query audit trail (Admin global; PM project-scoped — FR-AUD-01..06, G-08)
Latest risk snapshot for a project (FR-PIRAE-07)

patch.description: Does NOT modify project state. Human decision only. PIRAE remains advisory (§4.13 decision boundary).

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access JWT (15 min). Obtained via POST /auth/login. JTI blacklisted on logout (FR-AUTH-11, CA-06).

expiresIn.description: Access token lifetime in seconds (900 = 15 min)

criticalDecisions: CA-01 status enum = TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE
